notes.title: New Game Out Now + Huge QoL Update
notes.content:
Hello hello!

Two big pieces of news:

The Ghost of Glamping is out now!!

Fedoras at the ready! Polish your magnifying glass! Iron that long, sweeping trench coat! Our new Duck Detective game is out now, a brand new standalone no-murder mystery adventure. With CAMPING! 

Check out the launch trailer below…!

[previewyoutube=5ZcBzH9TmSg;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, we have polished up and fixed Duck Detective: The Secret Salami with a myriad of improvements, these include:

[list]
[*] Clue spots now turn gray if there is no new information
[*] Improved UI
[*] Improved performance
[*] Video playback improvements
[*] Fixed saving issues
[*] Fixed end cutscene replay issues
[/list]

On top of this, the game is currently on it's biggest sale at 30%! So now is the time to dive into the murky pond of delinquency and dredge up the truth!

~Happy Broccoli Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714620/

notes.title: Duck Detective March Update
notes.content:
Hello Detectives,

It's been a busy year so far for us, and it's only just beginning! Here's the biggest pieces of duck news:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/2afa9136d4bb6d44af7aa6a87a3bbd9e0ce19b2f.png[/img]

Duck Detective is coming to both Android and iOS on 9th April! You can find it [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/duck-detective-secret-salami/id6503263073]here on iOS[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snapbreak.duckdetective&hl=en]here on Google Play[/url] stores.

The game is perfect as a handheld experience, and now finally we can show our grandmas what we do for work and they can play! Give it a try or gift it to your own grandma!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/a465fb18492fb2a7bffe3bd4396faa5ef15b7747.png[/img]

The Duck Detective sequel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714620/]Ghost of Glamping now has a free demo you can try out over here[/url]

Go give it a go and let us know what you think on the Steam forums :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/5cad92b869c5ab5b70d7a7e7e6f486af87fba163.png[/img]

Finally, we are continuing to bundle with super awesome duck and detective themed games so keep your magnifying glass at the ready! Our newest bundle is with the wonderful Loco Motive, a detective thriller on a train, what more could you desire? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50687/Fowl_Play/]Check out the bundle here.[/url]

~the Happy Broccoli Team

notes.title: German Language & Workshop Support Update!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

We have two wonderful pieces of news!

We have added [b]German [/b]language support to Duck Detective, and we have also added Steam Workshop support so new unofficial translations can be added!

Localising the game ended up being a lot more work than we initially thought - it's very tricky translating deducktions to new languages. 

[b][i]HOWEVER[/i][/b]

We want to give you all the opportunity to enjoy Duck Detective in more languages so we have an extra surprise! 

We have added [b]Steam Workshop support[/b] to the game so anyone in the community can create translations!!

[b]Korean [/b]has already been included as a language in the workshop! A [i][b]big [/b][/i]thank you to [b]Ashtokki [/b]for providing their fan translation and helping iron out bugs with the workshop tools:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3333408741

To anyone interested, here you can find a guide on how to get started with localizing the game:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330385097

To celebrate the EGGcellent update we are doing our largest discount ever at [b]20% off[/b], so if you were on the fence, now is the best time to pick up the game! Buy it for a friend, overworked colleague, or estranged lover! There can never be enough duck in a person's life

Also check out this amazing fan-art of Eugene's office by [url=https://x.com/redux3d]Redux3d[/url] :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779292/5a1e6244b76bc983cc69e66d236aa05b6cc6d6e4.jpg[/img]

Also we are going to have a limited run physical edition on Switch starting 26th September! It comes with some exclusive Duck Detective content including never before seen early concepts of the game. Can find more info here: https://superraregames.com/



Thanks to all of you for your amazing support, and stay tuned for more cool updates that are in the works

~Happy Broccoli Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2637990
